integrity: The result is proved by reducing factual contraction to an exact row map on subsets and classifying when two such maps commute. The universal converse is witnessed inside the unconstrained model class by an empty accessibility row. The primary full text was checked at the contraction definition and its propositional preservation discussion; a distinct 2026 plausibility-based contraction paper was inspected for stronger iteration coverage.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to factual propositional contraction inputs in the unconstrained Kripke semantics. Modal contraction inputs can change one another's truth sets, so the fixed-set commutation law does not apply. The census counts semantic propositional equivalence classes, not syntax.
title: Exact commutation law for factual hedged belief contractions
